messages:
Maya: heads-up—starting Yeti15B-v2 quant/bringup today. initial int4 canary (batch=4, max_new_tokens=1024) hit OOMs on 3/8 hosts. logs attached in thread.
Sanjay: thanks. do you have the exact cmd you ran? curious about prefetch and kv settings.
Maya: ran this locally on a canary node:
```bash
python serve.py --model yeti15b-v2 --quant int4 --batch 4 --max_new_tokens 1024 --prefetch true
```
host log snippet: `OOM: allocate failed: 2.1GiB` right after first generation chunk.
Eli: my 2c: try batch=2 or reduce max_new_tokens to 512 for the canary. also check kv_cache_limit and evict_policy.
Zoe: QA found a small quality drop after int4 compared to int8 on some instruction-following prompts (delta BLEU ~2.4). will attach eval gist.
Maya: noted re: quality. priority for now is stability. lowering batch to 2 removed OOMs on 2 hosts but one host still crashed.
opsbot: memory fragmentation report: node-7 spike during allocation and high slab churn. suspected non-contiguous free ranges. link: http://internal/frag/node-7-2945678901
Sanjay: can we try enabling kv_trim=true and slot_reserve=0.15 on the bad host? that helped with other LLMs.
Maya: toggled kv_trim and slot_reserve=0.15, restarted canary. batch=2 + kv_trim stopped the crash on node-7. no obvious perf regressions.
Eli: perf numbers (canary avg latency / p95):
- batch=4 int8 max_new=1024: avg 190ms p95 480ms
- batch=4 int4 max_new=1024: OOM (failed)
- batch=2 int4 max_new=1024 + kv_trim: avg 220ms p95 520ms
- batch=2 int4 max_new=512 + kv_trim: avg 200ms p95 430ms
So smaller max_new tokens helps a lot.
Zoe: QA eval (subset):
- int8 @1024: Rouge-L 78.5
- int4 @1024: Rouge-L 76.1
- int4 @512: Rouge-L 76.9
Quality drop shrinks when we limit generation length. still a measurable delta vs int8.
Maya: proposal: default for yeti15b-v2 quantized endpoints -> batch_default=2, max_new_tokens_default=512, enable kv_trim=true, slot_reserve=0.15. keep int8 for high-quality tier.
Sanjay: +1. also recommend enabling adaptive_batching_offpeak to 4 for background workloads.
opsbot: created ticket INF-4239 to roll canary config to dedicated pool.
deploy-bot: canary deploy start: config yeti15b-v2-quant-stability-2945678901 -> 6 nodes.
Maya: canary is healthy at t+20m. no new OOMs. running overnight eval.
Zoe: will run extended eval tonight and send a report tomorrow morning with sample failures and prompt categories that regress. :mag:
Eli: follow-up item: add a perf benchmark that measures memory high-water mark vs max_new_tokens for int4/int8 so we can make automatic suggestions.
Maya: noted, I'll draft an RFC and link it here. thanks all. :thumbsup:
